# Parked public routes

The 0DTE Challenge is parked here so GitHub Pages does not publish `/odte-challenge/` until the desk is ready to manage one zero-day trade per day.

## Restore `/odte-challenge/`

1. Move `.github/parked/odte-challenge/` back to `/odte-challenge/` at the repo root.
2. Put the `0DTE Challenge` nav/footer/homepage links back on the live pages.
3. Remove `/odte-challenge/` from `robots.txt` `Disallow`.
4. Ship. `/odte-challenge/` and `/odte-challenge/#today` become the live product again.

Do not link this parked path from the public site.
